records.Name: How to report your hours in Atlântica TimeTrack
records.Summary__c: Submit your weekly hours correctly and on time.
records.Content__c:
When to submit

Hours are submitted weekly, by Friday at 18:00. Late timesheets delay client invoicing, so set a recurring reminder for Friday afternoon.

Step by step

  1. Open TimeTrack from the intranet home page and sign in with your company account.
  2. Select the current week. Each project you are assigned to appears as a row; if your project is missing, ask your project lead to add you.
  3. Enter your hours per day against the right project and activity code. Internal time (training, onboarding) goes on the INT-ONB code during your first month.
  4. Add a short comment for any day over 8 hours.
  5. Click Submit week. Your project lead approves it; you get an email if it is rejected.

Common mistakes

  • Saving without submitting: saved weeks are not sent for approval.
  • Booking everything on one project when you worked on two.

records.Name: How to submit an expense claim in Atlântica Expenses
records.Summary__c: Claim travel and work expenses with the right receipts.
records.Content__c:
What you can claim

Travel to client sites, approved training, and work meals with clients. Personal commuting is not reimbursed.

Step by step

  1. Open Expenses from the intranet and click New claim.
  2. Choose the category and the project to charge (or INT for internal costs).
  3. Photograph the receipt and attach it. Claims without a receipt are rejected.
  4. Submit within 30 days of the expense. Your manager approves it and payment follows in the next payroll.

Tip

You do not need a real expense during onboarding: open the form, check the categories and close it.

records.Name: How to raise a ticket with the Atlântica Service Desk
records.Summary__c: Get help with your laptop, accounts and access.
records.Content__c:
When to raise a ticket

Any issue with equipment, accounts, software or access to client systems. Do not ask colleagues for their credentials.

Step by step

  1. Open the Service Desk portal from the intranet.
  2. Choose Hardware, Access request or Software.
  3. Describe the problem and what you have already tried. For access requests, name the system and your project.
  4. Mark it Urgent only if you cannot work at all.

Response times

Standard tickets: within one working day. Urgent tickets: within two hours.
